output.summary: HERO of Oakland will run organized recess games and physical activity sessions at MLK/Lafayette Elementary School. Students will practice conflict management, safety, inclusion, responsibility and fair play. The cap is $30,000 for November 7, 2022 through May 25, 2023, and the period began before the board vote.

output.summary: Lincoln of Oakland will provide consultation and behavioral support for students in grades TK-5 with the highest needs at La Escuelita Elementary School. Services include in-class and playground support, individual, group and family therapy, teacher consultation, incentive plans, crisis intervention and community outings. The cap is $5,000 for July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023.

output.summary: Open Up Resources of Gladstone, Oregon will provide its Ignite! Reading program: one-on-one, fifteen-minute virtual tutoring sessions that target the word recognition skills each identified student needs. It serves students at Fred T. Korematsu Discovery Academy. The cap is $12,500 for September 12, 2022 through May 25, 2023, and the period began before the board vote.

output.summary: An individual consultant will give weekly leadership and executive coaching sessions to the Middle School Network superintendent, covering leadership, organizational, teaching and systems challenges. The cap is $10,000 for August 8, 2022 through May 31, 2023. The agreement period began before the board's ratification vote.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $4,700 for The SIFE Equity Project to train Oakland International High teachers
output.sourceIssueCandidate: The text calls the professional development series year long for 2022-2023 but lists a one-month period of November 1 through November 30, 2022.
output.summary: The SIFE Equity Project will develop a professional development series for twenty-eight 9th-12th grade teachers who teach about 380 students at Oakland International High School. The training focuses on teaching practices that help students participate in class. output.summary: An individual consultant will help with the registration process and support staff and families with technology issues at Edna Brewer Middle School. The consultant may also maintain, install and troubleshoot computers, printers and projectors. The cap is $5,000 for September 1, 2022 through May 25, 2023, and the period began before the board's ratification vote.

output.summary: The district accepts a $225,000 grant from the City of Oakland, through the Oakland Fund for Children and Youth. It pays support stipends for students in summer internships in the Exploring College, Career, and Community Options (ECCCO) Linked Learning pathway program at 13 high school sites. The grant period is June 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023.

output.summary: The American Association of Yemeni Students and Professionals will give students in after school programs an affinity space for the Arab American community, building cultural identity, leadership and advocacy skills. The district is buying through another agency's existing contract instead of running its own bid. The limit is $10,000,000 per fiscal year through June 14, 2024, with two possible one-year renewals through June 14, 2026. The text does not say what will be purchased.
